purpose: Zwei Entwürfe für das Vorschaubild des Homepage-Videos; noch nicht eingebunden.

variants.name: Fotografisch
variants.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: understated 16:9 landscape video poster for a dark Jackie Leven tribute homepage. Produce one finished image, 1536 x 864 pixels.
Input image: the supplied original video screenshot is the sole reference for the young Jackie Leven's identity, exact facial proportions, hair, clothing, microphone and performance gesture.
Primary request: Reinterpret this performance frame as a subtle, atmospheric neutral black-and-white photographic still. It should feel like a carefully printed archival concert photograph, intimate and alive, with a natural soft analogue texture rather than a digital filter.
Subject: preserve the specific young man's slightly open mouth mid-song, serious intent eyes, broad natural nose, swept-back shoulder-length hair, unidealized facial asymmetry and open patterned dark shirt. Keep the vintage silver microphone and visible hand gesture; no guitar. Preserve the natural body proportions and age.
Composition: waist-up performer just right of center, face in the upper-right-middle; enough breathing room above his hair. Preserve the recognizable pose. The left third is quiet, mostly dark negative space. Shoulder and lower torso gradually emerge from deep anthracite and fade at the bottom, without a rectangular cutout edge.
Scene/backdrop: simplify the television studio into darkness. Retain a very faint suggestion of the original rows of bulbs high in the background and one indistinct old TV shape at the far left, softly out of focus. These must stay peripheral and dimmer than the face.
Lighting/color: exclusively neutral black, charcoal and silver greys, no brown, sepia, orange or blue. Gentle directional stage light with clear readable midtones in the face; restrained highlights, no crushed facial features, no glamour lighting. Outer background near #0d0f12 to merge with a dark website.
Constraints: likeness over prettification; no invented smooth model face; no ageing; no hyper-sharp restored skin; no painterly brushstrokes; no cinematic smoke; no added objects; no lettering, captions, borders, logos, watermark or play icon.

variants.name: Bühne, gezeichnet
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: graphic 16:9 landscape video poster for a dark Jackie Leven tribute homepage. Produce one finished image, 1536 x 864 pixels.
Input image: the supplied original video screenshot is the sole identity and performance reference. Keep the actual young Jackie Leven's recognizable facial proportions, hair, clothes, microphone and gesture.
Primary request: Create a restrained hand-drawn monochrome interpretation of this TV performance, combining soft charcoal tonal drawing with sparse dry-ink marks and the quiet atmosphere of an old music broadcast. More graphic and spatial than a photograph, but human and subtle, never a crude stencil or repetitive digital filter.
Composition: a wider waist-up stage composition. Performer slightly right of center, original mid-song expression with slightly open mouth, attentive gaze, shoulder-length swept-back hair, open dark patterned shirt, microphone and hand gesture. Keep the face accurate and relatively resolved; reduce the patterned shirt to a few irregular strokes and merge torso edges into darkness. No guitar.
Scene/backdrop: use the distinctive rectangular rows of studio bulbs as broken dim grey dotted rhythms across the upper background. Suggest the original fan-shaped backdrop with a few broad shadow planes. Include two very faint, loosely drawn CRT silhouettes at far left and far right with barely legible light on their screens, subordinate to Jackie. Let large areas remain unworked dark space, especially left of him. No dazzling light effects.
Style/materials: expressive but economical charcoal and dry brush; irregular human marks, broad shadow shapes, a little matte paper grain in the lit areas. Keep facial structure and natural asymmetries, no beautification, no idealized sharp jaw. The face should remain readable at thumbnail size. Subtle abstraction of the stage and clothing rather than distortion of the face.
Palette/light: neutral black, graphite and silver grey ONLY, no brown/sepia or coloured tints. Near-black #0d0f12 background; moderate clear midtones in the face; softer and darker stage elements. Calm, raw concert presence.
Constraints: no text, typography, logos, watermark, border or play icon. No new props, guitar, audience or decorative collage elements. No aggressive grain overlay, mechanical crosshatching, glossy 3D or photographic skin-detail.
